about_the_game:
SkyInFlames

Experience intense aerial combat in this tactical military strategy game!

Take command of advanced drone swarms and sophisticated air defense systems in a realistic military simulation. SkyInFlames puts you at the forefront of cutting-edge military technology, where you plan and execute complex aerial operations.

SkyInFlames is a real-time tactical strategy (RTS) game. Defend power plants and transformers from strike drones. Command mobile AA units, S-300 systems, and engineers: minimize civilian casualties and prevent the destruction of critical infrastructure.

  • Objective: Protect power plants and transformers. Defeat occurs if 50% of protected objects are destroyed or if three power plants are lost. The fewer the civilian casualties, the better your score.

  • Units: Mobile anti-aircraft groups, S-300 (launcher and radar), engineering vehicles (repairing bridges and energy facilities, restocking missiles).

  • Key Features: Limited ammo and fuel, fog of war, and line-of-sight mechanics.

Note: This is a DEMO version showcasing core gameplay mechanics. The full version will include additional features, campaigns, and multiplayer modes. This game contains military themes and simulated warfare.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains military themes and simulated warfare. Intended for mature audiences.
